source: Phase 0 spike 3 (docs/spikes/phase-0.md) — reuses that spike's real, already-probed results by design; not re-probed here. See PROGRESS.md and DECISIONS.md #18: v1's size is a scope decision, not a limitation — Phase 5 owns expanding it, and the real registry is now known to hold 4,000+ npm candidates (data/registry/2026-09-05.json), far more than a v1 bootstrap pass should probe.

servers.name: notion-mcp-server
servers.note: Hands out its full tool schema with zero env vars set; auth is enforced at tools/call time, not tools/list time (Phase 0 spike 3). list-open here means 'schema capturable without credentials', not 'usable without an account' — see DECISIONS.md #12.

servers.name: mcp-server-linear
servers.note: Same caveat as notion-mcp-server (Phase 0 spike 3) — capturable without credentials, not usable without an account.

servers.name: sentry-mcp-server
servers.caveat: Promoted via a placeholder env var (not a real credential — DECISIONS.md #11's zero-secrets guarantee holds). The real tool list may vary by credential scope from what the placeholder probe saw (DECISIONS.md #12).

servers.name: server-brave-search
servers.caveat: Promoted via a placeholder env var (not a real credential). The real tool list may vary by credential scope from what the placeholder probe saw (DECISIONS.md #12).

servers.name: stripe-mcp
servers.reason: tools/list proxies to a live authenticated HTTP endpoint; a placeholder key gets a real 401 from that endpoint, and the local process hangs rather than failing cleanly — the probe's timeout is what ends it, not the server (Phase 0 spike 3). Kept in the seed list with no measurement, per DECISIONS.md #12.
